 Composible CDP 
 
 
 With a composable CDP, teams get a connected customer view fast and can activate insights across every channel. Go live in two months with a single, reliable customer profile and no data loss.
A modern star schema keeps data clean and easy to query, enabling faster segmentation, better reporting, and more accurate targeting. 
 
 
 D·engage Connects to Your Data Ecosystem 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Remote Source Connection 
 
 
 Access live data from your own systems without migration or duplication.
D·engage connects directly to your data sources, keeping everything in sync and reducing operational load. 
 
 
 See How D·engage Connects to Your Data Ecosystem 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Single Customer View 
 
 
 Combine online, offline, and transactional data into one connected identity.
See the full story of every customer across touchpoints and deliver experiences that reflect their true journey. 
 
 
 See How Dengage Connects to Your Data Ecosystem 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Flexible Infrastructure 
 
 
 Deploy D·engage your way, on-premise or in the cloud with enterprise-grade security and full governance control.
Maintain privacy and compliance while scaling confidently across teams and regions. 
 
 
 See How Dengage Connects to Your Data Ecosystem 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Smart Personalization 
 
 
 Build intelligent, behavior-based audience groups powered by unified and relational data.
Activate dynamic segments instantly to reach the right customers at the right time. 
 
 
 See How Dengage Connects to Your Data Ecosystem 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Zeki AI 
 
 
 Leverage built-in AI to automate insights, refine targeting, and predict next-best actions.
